:::{#rem-overfitting-causes}
#### Coefficients per observation

The rme notes tie overfitting to how many predictors a model has
relative to the data they are fitted to (see Source).
In @exr-overfitting,
each added power of `wt`, like an added predictor,
is one more coefficient fitted to the same 20 cars:
the degree-4 fit has five coefficients for those 20 cars.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

The rme notes' [definition of overfitting](https://morrison-lab.github.io/rme/chapters/predictor-selection.html#def-overfitting),
which says that overfitting
"results from including too many predictors relative to the effective sample size".
:::
